tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The LC to LC Single-Mode 2.0mm Fiber Optic Patch Cord is engineered for fast, stable, and long-range optical communication. Featuring high-precision LC/UPC connectors and OS2 single-mode fiber, this patch cord delivers excellent signal quality with ultra-low insertion loss.

The 2.0mm LSZH (Low Smoke Zero Halogen) jacket provides enhanced durability and safety, making it perfect for indoor telecom rooms, server racks, data centers, ISP networks, and FTTH deployments.

Ideal for connecting OLT, ONU, switches, routers, servers, media converters, and optical modules, this LC-LC single-mode patch cord is a reliable choice for both professional and commercial fiber networks in Bangladesh.


Key Features

  • LC to LC Single-Mode (OS2) Duplex Fiber Patch Cord
  • 2.0mm durable LSZH jacket for safe indoor installation
  • High-precision LC/UPC connectors
  • Ultra-low insertion loss & high return loss
  • Perfect for long-distance optical transmission
  • Supports 1G/10G/25G/40G network applications
  • Flexible, lightweight, easy to install
  • Ideal for OLT, ONU, switches, routers, and FTTH systems
  • RoHS, CE, and ISO certified quality
